# E0335: an orelse is not orelse(source path, fallback)

orelse takes two arguments: a reference into the source instance, and the
fallback to use when the referenced field is absent.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a?: string
}
```

`ship/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	b: string
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		b: orelse(v0_0.a)
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0335]: orelse takes two arguments: orelse(v0_0.<path>, fallback)
 --> 1.0.thema:8:6
  |
8 |         b: orelse(v0_0.a)
  |            ^^^^^^
  |

error[E0347]: 0.0 declares a and 1.0 does not, and nothing maps it: write <field>: v0_0.a to move it, or a: drop
 --> 1.0.thema:5:1
  |
5 | ForwardLens: {
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^
  |
```
